question: Protection of _______ is the fundamental duty of an Indian citizen.
solution:
The correct answer is __**wildlife**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idea of Fundamental Duties has been borrowed from the Constitution of the erstwhile USSR.
 
• Fundamental Duties are embedded in Part IV-A of the Indian Constitution under Article 51A.
